sequence.description: Ryan Jeffers flies out to left fielder Randy Arozarena.
Kody Clemens grounds out, first baseman Josh Naylor to pitcher Logan Gilbert.
Cole Young doubles (15) on a sharp line drive to right fielder Austin Martin.
Dominic Canzone walks. Cole Young to 3rd. Randy Arozarena to 2nd.
Julio Rodríguez singles on a ground ball to shortstop Ryan Kreidler. Cole Young scores. Randy Arozarena to 3rd. Dominic Canzone to 2nd.
Mitch Garver walks. Randy Arozarena scores. Dominic Canzone to 3rd. Julio Rodríguez to 2nd.
